V. Alonzo Echavarria-Garza

Libertarian candidate for Comptroller of Public Accounts, Texas · Challenger

City manager, City of Hearne, Texas

V. Alonzo Echavarria-Garza is the Libertarian nominee for Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has been city manager of Hearne since 2022, after serving as the city's chief financial officer from 2017 to 2022. He also ran for comptroller as a Libertarian in 2022 and lost.

Background

  • Libertarian candidate for Texas Comptroller, 2022 (lost)
  • City Manager, City of Hearne, 2022–present
  • Chief Financial Officer, City of Hearne, 2017–2022
  • Assistant Finance Director, City of Big Spring, 2014–2017
  • CFO, Clore Construction, LLC, 2013–2014
  • Finance Director, City of Port Isabel, 2008–2013
  • Auditor, Long Chilton, LLP, 2007
  • Listed occupation as CFO in state filings (per Texas Tribune)
